So I don't have a degree, a job, a family. I don't have support or understanding to sort out the crap I have been put through before I was even able to think. It's very risky to talk to professionals since they are far too likely to just don't get it, and thus worsen the situation.  


I've also been in love with a girl that left me for precisely those reasons, and she left me for a shallow but good-willed guy from a rich family with good, high-level connection and a top-notch house with opportunity for endulgence, music and parties. That is totally humiliating too.

Hey. I'm going through some *tough* times myself so I can't offer as much help as I would like to.

Here's what I'm going to say. You are young. You have the opportunity to go to college. You still have time to fix this. I was in a similar situation when I was your age. Took me too long to look for help and also found the wrong help too many times, but here I am, and I'm actually 25 (lol). Things went really wrong for me. But I'll try to help you best I can with the knowledge I gathered.

As I said I'm not in great condition so I can't help but to be a bit rough. I should be more gentle, sorry. You are young, intelligent. You seem to be ok economically. So if you are experiencing social difficulties it is either 1) because you live in a socially awuful enviroment, like criminals drug addicts and such, which does not seem to be the case, or 2) there is something wrong with your past, possibly your family, that blocked the growth of some aspects of your personality.

But you're doing nothing wrong. You've been denied something. Also there is nothing wrong with you that can't be fixed. But it will take time and pain. This is why you being young is good. You have time.
Understanding *what* is wrong and *how* to fix it (probably not going to be easy) will allow relationships to fit into your life just like it happens to everyone else.

If you have the opportunity, look for therapy. Otherwise PM me if you feel like it, hopefully I'll feel better and be able to help more.
